reproScope.real: Existing native H616 hardware byte-zero fixture: all 760 physical obstacles and 34-point outline; both before and after route all eight requests with connectivity and DRC acceptance. Uploaded local/spaced variants have their own authored placement/outline and are measured separately in the full TSX matrix.

comparisonLimit: Four renders time out in both variants, so their complete final Circuit JSON cannot be compared. The one 19-way matrix has timing variation; icepi-spaced was +6% overall despite faster bus phases, so a counterbalanced paired replay is run separately.

butterstickByte0Validation.scope: Byte zero of the original uploaded Butterstick-local TSX; whole board still reaches its 600-second limit

am3352.method: Fresh ./benchmark.sh --worker solves, base then head sequentially on the same runner for each sample; install both revisions before measuring. Only accepted complete and matched outputs are exported.

localProfilesPurpose: CPU diagnosis only; all timing comparisons use the recorded Blacksmith runs. Local snapshot test durations include mock counter overhead and are not used as benchmark claims.
pairedReplayInterpretation: Icepi-spaced averaged 308.383s base and 308.344s head in counterbalanced runs; its +6% in the contended matrix was not reproduced. Glider-local averaged 349.757s base and 292.339s head. All four Circuit JSONs are identical within each case.
limitations: No entire uploaded board fully routes. Fifteen settled renders are byte-identical; four timeouts prevent a complete final-Circuit-JSON comparison for those boards. Butterstick byte zero is independently validated complete, but the rest of that board still times out.
